open_questions: OWNER: ship_cap 24 to 6 makes the cap the real limiter, not the shared order pools (owner 2026-10-27 called it a backstop). Cause: the QA bots buy a ship whenever cash >= price, cash after the buy is ~0, and the reserve (N routes x fixed cost) then starves every Buy. Accept 6, or ask the programmer for a smarter buy gate (keep working capital) and then raise the cap.
UNKNOWN: mirror is optimistic for mining_focus (v5 real end cash median 220, mirror 900). If QA mining wins 0 of 8, raise Voltara ore_sell 12 to 14 first.
UNKNOWN: rescue_stipend 1000 > ship_price 900 lets a bot buy a ship and be rescued (+1000) when stranded; left as is (cap 6 limits it). Old saves with more than 6 ships keep them but cannot buy more.

sim_model.mirrors: route_engine.gd settle order: Buys (n = min(order, space, floor((cash - route_reserve)/price)), reserve = fixed cost of routes that will run, in list order, incl. _buy_feeds), routes (fixed cost paid from cash, stock moves src to dst, one ship per lane), Sells (min(order, stock), B3, Mixed load). main._check_stranded (rescue_stipend). Storage 100 per planet and good. Bot: tutorial ship, ranked lanes (profit*10 >= ship_price), buy ship when missing lanes > free ships and cash-price >= 0, permit at cash >= cost+400 with 3 points held, skill order, Buy order only if stock < 16 and cash >= fixed+price, cluster lanes for mining_focus. System 2 from data/systems.json, ore clusters, events from events.json (price, closure; silk/chips events are no-ops; EV17/EV18(from cycle 10)/EV20 fees paid when affordable).
sim_model.not_modelled: skill cover of closures, debris/shield/pirate effects, route removal churn, event timing gaps beyond a 12% skipped slot; effect: mirror is a little optimistic.
